subject.title: Dashboard: export / import / share a workspace config

question: Should dashboard workspace export/import/share be accepted as part of the bundled dashboard roadmap once the Wave 1 workspace stack exists on main?
rationale: Current main lacks the dashboard workspace substrate and this request adds a new distribution capability over persistent dashboard state, so automation cannot safely implement it before maintainers decide the base dashboard direction and storage/security contract.

options.title: Keep as Wave 2 child
options.body: Keep this issue open under the roadmap and revisit it after the Wave 1 dashboard stack has an accepted storage and security boundary.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Close this child as duplicate only if maintainers want all Wave 2 distribution work tracked solely in the roadmap issue.

options.title: Defer dashboard direction
options.body: Close or pause this issue if maintainers decide the modular dashboard workspace stack should not be bundled.

recommendation.title: Keep as Wave 2 child
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under the roadmap and revisit it after the Wave 1 dashboard stack has an accepted storage and security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the plugin-tab and Control UI product boundary this feature depends on.
